subject.title: fix(ui): treat started managed-service handoff as pending update instead of skipped

question: Should this PR keep the closing reference for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87889, or should it reference that issue without closing until final upgraded-version proof exists?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but merge semantics would close the broader Dashboard update report before the final post-handoff upgraded-version observation is proven.

options.title: Keep the closing reference
options.body: Merge as-is if maintainers accept the Docker/Chromium handoff-state proof plus source contract as sufficient for the remaining observable skipped-banner behavior.

options.title: Convert to a non-closing reference
options.body: Update the PR body to avoid auto-closing the linked issue, then land the UI fix while tracking final full-flow proof separately.

options.title: Request final upgraded-version proof
options.body: Pause merge until browser or log proof shows the detached handoff completes and the Dashboard observes the upgraded version.

recommendation.title: Keep the closing reference
recommendation.body: Merge as-is if maintainers accept the Docker/Chromium handoff-state proof plus source contract as sufficient for the remaining observable skipped-banner behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The closure/proof-scope choice is closest to the current Control UI overlay/update boundary and recent UI lifecycle work.
